Basic Bee.name: Basic Bee
Basic Bee.description: A simple and reliable bee with balanced abilities. It gathers pollen steadily, converts resources efficiently, and supports your hive with consistent performance. Perfect for beginners building a strong and dependable foundation.

obtain.detail: You begin the game with one Basic Bee already in your hive.

abilities.name: Steady Gather
abilities.description: Passively increases pollen collection rate by 5% for every 10 levels the bee gains.

abilities.name: Pollen Burst
abilities.description: Releases a burst of pollen in a wide radius, instantly collecting from all nearby flowers.

abilities.name: Nectar Trail
abilities.description: Leaves a glowing nectar trail that boosts pollen collection for all bees passing through it.

trivia: Basic Bee is the only bee that is guaranteed to hatch from a Basic Egg.
Despite being a Common rarity, a fully leveled Basic Bee can outperform some Rare bees in white flower fields.
Basic Bee's design was the very first bee concept created during development.

Azure Bee.name: Azure Bee
Azure Bee.description: A calm bee infused with cool energy, boosting blue pollen collection and refreshing nearby flowers. Its soothing aura increases efficiency and supports allies, making it essential for steady resource gathering and growth.

obtain.detail: Can hatch from a Silver Egg (Rare pool).
Has a chance to transform any bee into Azure Bee.

abilities.name: Cool Aura
abilities.description: Emits a cooling aura that refreshes nearby flowers, extending their pollen availability by 20%.

abilities.name: Ice Crystal
abilities.description: Fires a shard of ice that freezes everything in its path solid.

abilities.name: Wind Gust
abilities.description: Unleashes a powerful gust of wind that sweeps pollen tokens toward the hive automatically.

abilities.name: Tidal Surge
abilities.description: Calls a wave of water energy that washes over the field, saturating all blue flowers and amplifying their yield.

trivia: Azure Bee was originally designed as an Epic rarity but was moved to Rare during balancing.
Its cooling aura stacks with Cold Bee's freeze effect, making them a powerful pair.

Thunder Bee.name: Thunder Bee
Thunder Bee.description: A tempestuous bee crackling with electric fury, its form wreathed in storm clouds that pulse with veins of lightning. It calls forth thunderous roars that shake the earth and ignite the air with cascading bolts, charging nearby flowers with raw electrical energy that accelerates their growth while its crackling aura surges through the area in violent, electrifying waves of pure storm-born power.

obtain.detail: Guaranteed Legendary from a Diamond Egg.
Small chance from Golden Egg (Legendary pool).
Rare chance to transform any bee into Thunder Bee.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.description: Thunder Bee constantly radiates a static field. Enemies that enter a 6-tile radius are slowed by 15% and take 2 damage per second.

abilities.name: Thunder Strike
abilities.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning that electrifies flowers and stuns enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Speed Surge
abilities.description: Overcharges the bee's wings for a brief burst of incredible speed.

abilities.name: Storm Caller
abilities.description: Summons a localized storm above the field that drops constant lightning strikes for 12 seconds, charging all flowers it hits with electrical energy for 2x pollen yield.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.description: When Thunder Strike is used, the next 5 pollen collections within 3 seconds deal 20% bonus yield due to lingering electrical charge.

trivia: Thunder Bee is one of only three bees whose passive ability deals damage without any player input.
During development, Storm Caller originally lasted 30 seconds and was considered too powerful.
The crackling sound Thunder Bee makes was recorded from an actual tesla coil.
Thunder Bee pairs exceptionally well with Windy Belt from the White Shop due to the +75% Loot Luck synergy.
